integrity: Every all-size theorem has an explicit algebraic proof; the supplementary finite-state checks are not offered as infinite certificates. The listed prior papers study distinct interaction graphs or spin types; some closely related journal full texts were inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Only the equal-exchange classical \(K_4\square C_n\) tube is treated. Fields below \(3J\) for odd period, quantum dynamics, unequal bonds and finite-temperature transitions are not classified. Historical-priority review is provisional.
title: Critical subset-exclusion spectra on a tetrahedral-rung Ising tube
